visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair wears a white lace headscarf and a white top. She poses playfully with a pink Dior makeup bag on her head and various black and white Dior cushion compacts. The scene is brightly lit with a soft indoor background. (2) Close-up shots of Dior makeup products appear on a white fluffy rug, including cushion foundations and lipsticks with bold 'MISS DIOR' typography. The woman is seen in a grey sports bra and jeans, leaning on a chair in a bright studio environment. (3) The woman is shown applying the cushion foundation to her face using a puff. She is in a neutral indoor setting with soft lighting. (4) A split-screen comparison shows the 'Before' and 'After' effects of the foundation on her skin. (5) The woman speaks directly to the camera, showcasing the foundation's finish and pointing to specific areas of her face. (6) She applies a 'MISS DIOR' lipstick and continues to pose in various outfits, including a walk toward the camera in a grey top and jeans, then back in the white lace scarf.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic jazz piano and a light drum beat establish a cheerful, sophisticated atmosphere. No vocals are present. (2) A clear female voice with a friendly, professional tone begins narrating in Traditional Chinese, describing the makeup product. The music continues at a steady, moderate tempo in the background. (3) A subtle mechanical click is heard as a makeup compact is opened, perfectly integrated into the narration. The speaker maintains a bright and engaging pitch. (4) The narration continues with detailed descriptions of facial features and product effects. The BGM maintains its major-key tonality and light texture. (5) As the demonstration concludes, the female voice fades out while the BGM swells slightly before a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Miss Dior cushion foundation and lipstick by demonstrating their effectiveness, showing high-quality packaging, and creating an aspirational lifestyle aesthetic.
